content.orbitSubtext: Solar-steeped over 21 days with 18 pure active herbs, roots, seeds, and petals. Hover over any ingredient to explore its restorative hair-care benefits.

orbit.name: Coconut Oil
orbit.desc: Pure cold-pressed virgin oil that penetrates deep into hair shafts, sealing in moisture and halting protein loss.

orbit.name: Hibiscus Flower
orbit.desc: Rich in natural amino acids and vitamin C that stimulate dormant hair follicles and promote thick regrowth.

orbit.name: Fenugreek
orbit.desc: Packed with natural lecithin and proteins that deeply hydrate strands, repair damage, and impart silky shine.

orbit.name: Aloe Vera
orbit.desc: Succulent botanical gel with proteolytic enzymes that soothe scalp inflammation and balance healthy pH levels.

orbit.name: Neem Leaves
orbit.desc: Potent antiseptic green leaves that clear dandruff flakes, purify scalp pores, and prevent persistent itching.

orbit.name: Curry Leaves
orbit.desc: Abundant in beta-carotene and essential amino acids that preserve natural dark pigmentation and prevent greying.

orbit.name: Amla (Gooseberry)
orbit.desc: Sacred Ayurvedic rasayana packed with ascorbic acid that strengthens keratin bonds and stops premature thinning.

orbit.name: Brahmi
orbit.desc: Traditional brain tonic herb that cools excess cranial heat, alleviates mental tension, and reinforces root fibers.

orbit.name: Bhringraj
orbit.desc: The revered classical sovereign of Ayurvedic hair science. Activates micro-circulation across scalp beds.

orbit.name: Tulsi (Holy Basil)
orbit.desc: Sacred adaptogenic foliage with antimicrobial eugenol that defends follicles against environmental toxins.

orbit.name: Rose Petals
orbit.desc: Handpicked crimson petals that impart a soothing floral aromatherapy while toning sensitive scalp dermal layers.

orbit.name: Vetiver Root
orbit.desc: Earthy golden grass roots with profound cooling properties that eliminate scalp irritation and excessive oiliness.

orbit.name: Shikakai
orbit.desc: Mild botanical pods with natural saponins that wash away sebum without disrupting delicate cuticle integrity.

orbit.name: Reetha (Soapnut)
orbit.desc: Gentle fruit pods that yield a luxuriously cushiony cloud foam, leaving hair buoyant, detangled, and radiant.

orbit.name: Indigo Leaves
orbit.desc: Ancient indigo leaves that enrich natural hair gloss, intensify strand depth, and shield against UV sun-bleaching.

orbit.name: Black Sesame Oil
orbit.desc: Deep-penetrating dark seed oil that acts as the bioavailable carrier for 21 days of natural solar maturation.

orbit.name: Castor Oil
orbit.desc: Viscous ricinoleic acid-rich oil that coats each shaft, dramatically minimizing breakage and sealing split ends.

orbit.name: Lavender Flower
orbit.desc: Pure calming lavender blossom essential oil that relaxes the nervous system and delivers our signature fragrance.

products.description: Crafted in small batches according to classical Ayurvedic texts. Nachiyar Herbal Hair Oil features deep-steeped cold-pressed oils enriched with Bhringraj, Amla, Brahmi, and delicate lavender blossom essence. Calms scalp inflammation, repairs dry split ends, and delivers noticeable root strength within two weeks of regular application.
benefits: Clinically proven hair fall reduction in 14 days
Soothes irritated, dry scalp with calming lavender aromatherapy
Deeply bioavailable: absorbs without heavy mineral grease
Encourages dense follicle growth and strand thickness
products.ingredients: Cold-Pressed Black Sesame Oil, Virgin Coconut Oil, Pure French Lavender Oil (Lavandula Angustifolia), Bhringraj, Amla, Brahmi, Hibiscus Blossom, Fenugreek, Rosemary, Indian Nardostachys (Jatamansi).
